THEY ARE NOT ADDITIONAL HOMES -- they are the same two files compiled, and counting them inflates the denominator with artifacts of the runtime. REGISTRATION HOMES: at FILE grain the estate has FIVE files carrying @mcp.tool -- tools.py (34), integrations/ycharts/integration.py (6), destructive_ops.py (1), integrations/base.py (1), integrations/opal_portal/integration.py (1). THE PRE-STATE IS THE POINT OF THE CRITERION: the deployed vintage 5a1cc39e8e carried ZERO marks (measured), so this deploy takes them 0 -> 5 and changes which tools are resident at session start FOR EVERY MCP SEAT. That is a fabric-wide behaviour change riding inside what reads like a formatting deploy.

surprises: THE DEPLOY LANDED AND ITS OWN RECORD WAS REFUSED. safe-ec2-deploy returned rc=0 and then its manifest commit hit an owned-paths lane refusal, leaving the change STAGED and the source of truth asserting the previous commit while new code ran. Rule 26 moved the apply to the seat that owns the work; it did not move the lane that owns the record. Structural, reproduces for every future site-Z EC2 deploy, and the second instance today of the same shape as the safe-apply terraform-path defect.

RE-SERIALISING THE MANIFEST WOULD HAVE FROZEN SOMEONE ELSE'S CORRUPTION. The file already contains MOJIBAKE -- double-encoded em-dashes -- in six other services' rows. json.dumps with ensure_ascii would have escaped that mojibake into permanent \u00e2\u20ac\u201d sequences, converting recoverable corruption into machine-readable-looking garbage, in rows I have no business touching. Caught by reading the diff rather than the return code; redone byte-surgically with every anchor asserted unique first.

THE WRAPPER REWROTE 555 LINES AS CRLF FOR FOUR SEMANTIC CHANGES. Every gate would have passed and only the review surface would have died -- the same class as the Lambda source-map ensure_ascii slip earlier in this same session, from a different cause. Twice in one session the diff SHAPE was the only thing that caught it.

TWO file_checksums ENTRIES WERE ALREADY WRONG BEFORE THIS DEPLOY. app/server.py and app/audit.py matched neither the repo nor the box (the box matched the repo -- only the record was stale). Rule 8's source of truth was partially false and nothing was reporting it. Their correction is stated as pre-existing in the record itself, because an unexplained checksum change inside a deploy record reads as exactly the drift it is not.

MY OWN COMMIT MESSAGE MISCOUNTED ITS OWN ARTIFACT. 2b7258f31c says '6/6 alwaysLoad marks' and the file AT THAT COMMIT carries 5 -- measured at three vintages. The gate's amendment said 4 + 1 and was right. A self-report in a commit message is not evidence about the commit.
